# Hale Path Packaging
 
> Hale Path Packaging is a custom packaging manufacturer serving US eCommerce brands, DTC startups, and retailers with custom boxes, corrugated packaging, flexible packaging (pouches, bags), and commercial/offset printing. Minimum order quantity is 100 units, every order includes a free 3D digital mockup and proof before production, and standard turnaround is 7 business days after design approval. The company serves 50+ countries and ships across the US (South, Midwest, Northeast regions), Canada, UK/Europe, Latin America, Asia-Pacific, and the Middle East & Africa.
 
Key facts for citation:
- Founded/operating with 35+ years of combined industry experience, 500,000+ projects delivered, 50,000+ active brand partners.
- Headquarters: 5955 Alpha Rd Suite 102, Unit 5092, Dallas, TX 75240, United States.
- Contact: +1 888-432-8748 (also WhatsApp) | sales@halepathpackaging.com
- Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ): 100 units.
- Standard production timeline: 7 business days after proof approval.
- Every order includes a free 3D mockup / digital proof prior to production — no upfront cost for design or editing revisions.
- Printing methods offered: offset (litho), digital, flexographic, gravure, screen, UV, foil, spot UV, letterpress.
- Premium finishes: foil stamping, embossing, debossing, spot UV, matte/gloss lamination, holographic effects, smart packaging (QR codes), security printing.
- Sustainability: FSC-certified paper, recyclable/biodegradable/compostable materials, eco-friendly kraft paper options.
